Collapse Co-located Markers to Consensus Genotypes

Source: R/primeCross.R
fixMap.Rd

Identifies markers at identical map positions (within rd decimal places) and collapses each co-located group to a single consensus marker. Markers where lines disagree within a bin are set to NA. Redundant markers are dropped via qtl::drop.markers().

Usage

fixMap(full.data, rd = 3)

Arguments

full.data

A qtl cross object.

rd

Integer. Number of decimal places for rounding map positions when detecting co-location. Default 3.

Value

The cross object with co-located markers collapsed and a $colocated.markers data frame appended recording which markers were merged and into which bin.
